title: Flesh

vibeProfile.oneLine: One man's whole life, watched in cool, unsparing close-up.

summary: Szalay follows one man, Istvan, from a Hungarian housing estate through the army, wealth and London society across the whole arc of a life, in the spare, watchful style that has become his signature. Told largely through flat, restrained dialogue and the spaces between what people say, it is a novel about bodies, money, sex and the strange passivity with which a life can happen to a person. Cool and precise, it asks how much any of us really author our own story.
whyReadIt: A cool, precise novel that watches a whole life drift by. Spare on the surface, but it accumulates real weight.

funFacts.text: David Szalay's earlier novel All That Man Is was shortlisted for the Booker Prize.
